components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single dominant action in a viewport.
components.css: .ds-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ff9d00; color: #0a0a0f; padding: 14px 22px; font: 600 12px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; transition: transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), background .24s; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #ffb43d; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quieter translucent action for supporting paths.
components.css: .ds-secondary { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: #fff; padding: 14px 22px; backdrop-filter: blur(20px); font: 600 12px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; transition: background .24s, border-color .24s; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.13); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff9d00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,157,0,.56); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); color: #fff; padding: 10px 14px; font: 600 11px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-chip span { color: #ff9d00; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Instrument Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(13,14,21,.58); color: #fff; padding: 10px 12px 10px 18px; backdrop-filter: blur(24px); font-family: Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font: 700 18px/1 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong span { color: #ff9d00; } .ds-nav a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); text-decoration: none; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav button { border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #ff9d00; color: #0a0a0f; padding: 11px 14px; font: 600 11px/1 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Stephen.Tech treats finished work as the atmosphere, not as content placed below a sales pitch. Projects sit under optically layered glass while the shader behaves like slow studio light moving across the surface. Glass is functional: it groups controls, creates depth over moving media, and keeps type legible.
keyCharacteristics: Thin luminous edges define depth more than heavy shadows.
Ember is a directional signal, not a decorative wash.
Inter carries decisive display statements; Geist carries navigation, metadata, and body copy.
Motion reveals relationships between projects and systems.

rules.name: The Ember Compass Rule
rules.body: Ember indicates where to look or act next. It does not decorate every element.

rules.name: The One Lens Rule
rules.body: A viewport gets one dominant glass plane.

dos: Do let real project imagery or motion dominate the first viewport.
Do use glass to preserve legibility over the shader and media.
Do vary section density and composition while preserving the same material grammar.
donts: Don't stack identical centered heading-and-card sections down the page.
Don't block the first visit with a timed loading screen.
Don't fabricate testimonials, metrics, form success, or production behavior.
